cucumber Options

Source: R/doc-opts.R
opts.Rd

Internally used, package-specific options. They allow overriding the default behavior of the package.

Details

The following options are available:

  • cucumber.path

    Directory with .feature files that test() runs and features_rd() reads when called without path.

    default: "tests/acceptance"

  • cucumber.language

    Language of the feature files without a # language: line, like "fr".

    default: "en"

  • cucumber.docstring_as_lines

    If TRUE, step definitions get a Doc String as a character vector of lines, like in cucumber 2.x, instead of one string.

    default: FALSE

  • cucumber.reporter_max_docstring_lines

    Max docstring lines CucumberPrettyReporter prints per step before truncating.

    default: Inf

  • cucumber.reporter_max_table_lines

    Max data table rows CucumberPrettyReporter prints per step before truncating.

    default: Inf

  • cucumber.rd_tags

    Tag expression of the scenarios features_rd() puts in help pages.

    default: "@rd"

  • cucumber.rd_section

    Name of the section features_rd() puts scenarios in.

    default: "Behavior"

See base::options() and base::getOption() on how to work with options.

Behavior






Feature: Language


A # language: line at the top of a feature file sets the language of its keywords,
like in the official Gherkin parser. The languages are the ones in the official gherkin-languages.json.
Step definitions don't change, because steps are matched without their keyword.
The cucumber.language option sets the language of feature files without a # language: line.


Background:
  • Given a package
    • 





Scenario: The cucumber.language option sets the language of feature files without a language line
  • Given a file named "features/addition.feature" with
    Fonctionnalité: Addition
  Scénario: Adding one
    Soit I have 1
    Quand I add 1
    Alors I should have 2
    • 

  • And a file named "features/subtraction.feature" with

    # language: en
Feature: Subtraction
  Scenario: Taking one
    Given I have 2
    When I add -1
    Then I should have 1
    • 

  • And a file named "features/setup-steps.R" with
    given("I have {int}", function(n, context) {
  context$n <- n
})
when("I add {int}", function(n, context) {
  context$n <- context$n + n
})
then("I should have {int}", function(n, context) {
  expect_equal(context$n, n)
})
    • 

  • When I run
    withr::with_options(list(cucumber.language = "fr"), test("features"))
    • 

  • Then the scenarios have these results:
    scenariostatus
    Adding onepassed
    Taking onepassed
